title: Dad and mom are not at home
simplified_paragraphs: 今天爸爸妈妈不在家，我和弟弟妹妹在家。
妹妹想喝可乐，吃米饭；弟弟想喝茶，吃面条；我想喝咖啡，吃面包。但是我不会做米饭和面条，他们不喜欢面包，这是个问题。
爸爸妈妈什么时候回家呢？
traditional_paragraphs: 今天爸爸媽媽不在家，我和弟弟妹妹在家。
妹妹想喝可樂，吃米飯；弟弟想喝茶，吃麵條；我想喝咖啡，吃麵包。但是我不會做米飯和麵條，他們不喜歡麵包，這是個問題。
爸爸媽媽什麼時候回家呢？
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn tiān bà ba mā ma bù zài jiā， wǒ hé dì di mèi mei zài jiā。
mèi mei xiǎng hē kě lè， chī mǐ fàn； dì di xiǎng hē chá， chī miàn tiáo； wǒ xiǎng hē kā fēi， chī miàn bāo。 dàn shì wǒ bù huì zuò mǐ fàn hé miàn tiáo， tā men bù xǐ huan miàn bāo， zhè shì gè wèn tí。
bà ba mā ma shén me shí hou huí jiā ne？
english_paragraphs: My parents are not at home today, my brothers, sisters and I are at home.

My sister wants to drink Coke and eat rice; my brother wants to drink tea and eat noodles; I want to drink coffee and eat bread. But I can't make rice and noodles, and they don't like bread, so that's a problem.
When will mom and dad come home?
english_full:
My parents are not at home today, my brothers, sisters and I are at home.

My sister wants to drink Coke and eat rice; my brother wants to drink tea and eat noodles; I want to drink coffee and eat bread. But I can't make rice and noodles, and they don't like bread, so that's a problem.

When will mom and dad come home?
